question: How do the six fixed identity/effector target source-average contrasts differ between first and second WT IL-4 stimulation in the already qualified GSE115504 table?
decision: Clarify the exact target context for induction versus repeat stimulation; do not infer maintenance or repeat the full source analysis.
strongest_rival: Source averaging, different stage baselines, normalization ambiguity and offset-sensitive low expression can mimic a stable history response.
discriminator: All four WT source averages and the frozen first, second, baseline and second-minus-first contrasts at both offsets for the six prespecified symbols.
exposure_record: Full-table source-average outputs and the independent six-target induction screen are exposed. Exact target identifiers were inspected before this freeze; new six-target repeat-stage values were not inspected. This is a new exposed view of already computed source data, not independent validation.
biological_unit: Author-supplied RNA group averages from cultured macrophages; effective biological n and individual variance are unknown.
nesting_and_overlap: Both offsets and all six genes reuse the same four source averages; no independent biological replication or pairing of individual preparations is inferred.
population_and_selection: Exact WT source rows Stat6,Egr2,Pparg,Rxra,Irf4,Arg1; no KO selection, new genes, zero-row exclusion or outcome ranking.
contrast: First-stage and second-stage source-average log ratios, their difference and the baseline shift, at offsets1.0/0.5.
endpoint: Twelve gene/offset rows with four supplied WT averages and four inherited log2-ratio endpoints; ARG1 remains a separate effector.
methods: Extract exact rows from frozen contrasts; independently recompute scalar log2 ratios from four original WT averages, requiring parity within1e-10; preserve both baselines and offsets.
missingness_and_exclusions: Missing or duplicate gene/offset/column IDs, negative/nonfinite source averages or arithmetic failure stop the run. All-zero rows are retained.
multiplicity: All six targets and two offsets retained; no tests, ranking, score or uncertainty estimates.
precision_basis: Author group averages do not expose preparation variance or effective biological n. Arithmetic tolerance is not biological precision.
interpretation_limit: Author-labelled averaged CPM/Cufflinks has normalization ambiguity. No individual temporal response, post-cessation maintenance, causal interaction, NAM/infection transfer, protein activity or mechanistic proof.
stop_rule: Stop on hash/identifier/column/value/parity conflicts and retain failed evidence; no target or offset changes.
amendment_reason: New separately scoped exposed fixed-target view; original whole-table and induction contracts/results remain unchanged.
